Normally Miss Information is easier with fewer heroes because you don’t have to suffer as long before she flips. But with her Clue chaining in challenge mode she flips pretty no matter how many heroes you have.

Dreamer also is easier with fewer heroes, because her flipside damage output increases with H squared. But I used Legacy to tank all psychic damage, so that too is a non-issue.
